mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.content, p.image, p.like_count, p.create_time, p.status, u.username AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, c.name AS category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment cm WHERE cm.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count FROM t_post p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_category c ON p.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_post (user_id, category_id, content, image, like_count, create_time, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{content}, #{image}, 0, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, content, image, like_count, create_time, status FROM t_post WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_post SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_post SET like_count = CASE WHEN like_count > 0 THEN like_count - 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(p.id) AS value FROM t_category c LEFT JOIN t_post p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT t.day AS day, SUM(t.cnt) AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_post GROUP BY DATE(create_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_comment GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) t WHERE DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), t.day) < #{days} GROUP BY t.day ORDER BY t.day ASC
